sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/352 (ReserveOhio API ohiordr.usedirect.com: search/place PlaceId 352, search/grid facilities 444 'Sites 1-120' and 445 'Sites 121-217' for 2027-06-15 and 2027-01-12, search/details for every unit on 2027-06-15, plus sites 208, 001 and 040 on 2027-06-19, 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12, read 2026-10-30)

values.note: Non-electric sites $29 a night, electric $39, full hookups $52, the same on a Saturday (June 2027). Off-peak (November 2026, January 2027) non-electric $25, electric and full-hookup $35. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-30.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all Grand Lake St. Marys campsites, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Non-Electric 29.00 with 25-ft pads and 50x30-ft sites, Campsite Electric 39.00, Campsite Full Hookup 52.00, Fee 6.50); sites 208, 001, 040 on Sat 2027-06-19 (29.00 / 39.00 / 52.00), 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12 (25.00 / 35.00 / 35.00), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: ReserveOhio search/details (every electric and full-hookup site lists Electricity Hookup '50'; the 33 full-hookup sites list Water Hookup and Sewer Hookup 'Yes') + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/grand-lake-st-marys-state-park-campground ('34 Full Hookup sites', '154 Electric sites'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 187 web-bookable sites (10 non-electric with 25-ft grass pads, 144 electric, 33 full hookup), rated for camping units 25-62 ft; 50 electric sites are pull-through. ODNR counts 34 full-hookup, 154 electric and 10 non-electric sites, plus camper cabins and Cedar Cabins. Pets permitted on all sites except around the cabins.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/grid (444: 100 units, 445: 94 incl. cabins) + search/details (PullInTypeName 'Back In' / 'Pull Through', Maximum Camping Unit Length 25-62) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/grand-lake-st-marys-state-park-campground ('34 Full Hookup sites', '154 Electric sites', '10 Non-electric sites'; 'Pets are permitted on all sites except for the area in and around the cabins.'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Full-service camp store (also bike rentals), boat launch and docks/tie-ups for registered campers, swimming beach, splash pad, mini-golf, campers' dog park.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/grand-lake-st-marys-state-park-campground ('Flush toilets, showers and laundry'; 'Filling station and dump station'; 'Boat launch and boat docks/tie-ups for registered campers'; 'Full-service camp store open to the public offers bike rentals'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 'Reservations are required and may be made up to six months in advance, online or by calling (866) 644-6727.' Every listed campsite is web-bookable with a 14-night maximum on ReserveOhio.

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/grand-lake-st-marys-state-park ('Reservations are required and may be made up to six months in advance, online or by calling (866) 644-6727.') + ReserveOhio search/details (AllowWebBooking true, MaxStay 14), read 2026-10-30

summary: Fees confirmed ($29 non-electric RV base, +$10 electric, +$23 full hookup) and added the off-peak rates. Added 50-amp electric with water/sewer, 187 sites to 62 ft with 50 pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/dump/laundry/camp store, ReserveOhio deep link, 6-month window, reservations required, 14-night max. Season left as stored (manual, and the January grid agrees: sites 1-120 partly open, 121-217 blocked). Pin fine (202 m from the centroid). Stored lakeview: ODNR says only 'access to the lake, boat docks, and tie-ups', no lakefront-site wording.
